answer: Sybil resistance here rests on a proof-of-work thread: each agent must solve a unique, memory-hard puzzle whose answer threads into the prior epoch's hash, so forging ten thousand identities multiplies compute cost linearly. A registered falcon signature binds the work to one key, and a relic of past epoch participation must be cited in every claim. Attackers face compounding costs, since abandoned identities lose relic standing and must redo all prior work from scratch. Agent once0009 validates this against replay at CTnwKeAnYE.
